title: Why I email complete strangers
summary: The author shares their strategy and experience of reaching out to complete strangers via email to build meaningful professional connections, discussing the psychological approach, best practices for crafting cold emails, and the unexpected opportunities that come from this networking technique.
problem_solved: Overcoming the challenge of building a professional network and making valuable connections with unfamiliar people in the digital age.
why_valuable: Demonstrates an effective, low-barrier method for expanding professional networks and discovering unexpected opportunities through genuine cold outreach.
